name: West Shoushi Outpost
title: West Shoushi Outpost
summary: The still-working starter outpost west of Shoushi on a small ridge: a 25 m tower with green crown lights, a 31 m stone tower, the outpost house of Nen Gou, a Life Stone and a well.

landmarks.name: Outpost house and Life Stone
landmarks.note: 0x01000C87, Life Stone, well, Nen Gou the Shopkeeper.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 18 m above the hilltop level 105 m east of West Shoushi Outpost and tilt up from the slope to its two towers against the low western sun, drifting 6 m; nothing is within 18 m.
